bootstrap.method: paired whole-case bootstrap (cells of a case stay together, same resamples for every model and statistic)
bootstrap.note: optimistic: cells within a case are spatially correlated and consecutive days are serially correlated

definitions.all_cells: every paired cell of the case population (zones are subsets of it)
definitions.q1: metric(zone, model) - metric(all cells, model); bias = forecast - observation
definitions.q2: [metric(zone, model) - metric(zone, Raw)] - [metric(all cells, model) - metric(all cells, Raw)]; rmse and CSI
definitions.regime_assignment: argmax of the frozen forecast-only pseudo-regime classifier probability; pseudo-labels, not meteorological truth

fss.reason: Not reported in Stage 1: the protocol reports FSS only where a zone is spatially contiguous enough; the zones are scattered cell sets (coast strip, escarpment, mixed interior), so a neighbourhood score would mix zone and non-zone cells.
